name: Marcus T.
text: Finally someone explaining the latency issues with exchange APIs. I've been debugging connection timeouts for weeks on Binance's WebSocket feeds. Great breakdown of how order placement speed actually matters.

name: Sarah K.
text: Question: does anyone else run multiple bot instances across different exchanges simultaneously? I'm worried about capital allocation conflicts between my algos.

name: David P.
text: Solid article but you glossed over authentication security. API keys sitting in environment variables is risky. I learned that the hard way losing 0.5 BTC to a compromised bot last year.
